Commentary.Commentary: That's all from this match. The last T20I will be played tomorrow, so do join us at 1230 local (1630 GMT) for all the action. Cheers!

West Indies skipper, Carlos Brathwaite says he's very pleased with the attitude and passion shown by his team. Adds the way his team pulled it back after the first 5 overs was splendid. Mentions it was good to restrict Pakistan to 130 as at one stage they were looking good for 160. Lauds Evin Lewis for his phenomenal knock and also credits Jason Mohammed for the way he played with so much positivity on debut. Also adds that he wants his boys to do the same tomorrow. Credits his boys for the perfect game as they showed a lot of intensity and passion, especially towards the end of the innings with the ball. Thanks the fans for coming out and wants to give them something in return for their massive support.

Man of the Match, Evin Lewis says that he is really happy with his performance. Remembers that he got run out in the last two games and is pleased to contribute today. Adds that he stays positive and tries to give good start to the team. Also says that he is working hard on his game in the nets.

Pakistan skipper, Sarfraz Ahmed says he doesn't think they got a good total. Adds Babar Azam and Kamran Akmal played well but the rest of his team couldn't end well. States two of their set batsmen got out at the wrong time. Mentions it wasn't their day as Evin Lewis played a blinder of a knock. Ends by saying that they would like to come back hard and win the series in the final game.

That was a stroll in the park for the West Indies. Chasing a target of 138 on a slowish track, they lost Chadwick Walton cheaply but Evin Lewis rose to the occasion. He once again showed his hitting prowess as he plundered 91 runs off just 51 balls to single-handedly take West Indies home. It was a relatively low target and a couple of fifty stands were enough to scale it down. Pakistan were dismal with the ball and their fielding wasn't great either. Series now stands 2-1 and West Indies have given themselves a chance to draw level.

FOUR! West Indies win by 7 wickets and 31 balls to spare! Flatter and shorter around off, 95 kph, Simmons gets back and forces it straight down the ground, beating mid on for a boundary. Handshakes all around and the crowd is celebrating.
Lendl Simmons walks into the middle next with the bat.

OUT! Lewis holes out but not before doing the damage. Just 4 more needed off 32 balls. Flighted full ball on middle, probably a googly, Lewis swings his bat hard and mistimes his shot down to long off. Wahab Riaz in the deep runs in a bit, nearly misjudges but then does well to catch it in the end. Smile on his face says it all.
Googly around off, Lewis taps it down to short third man.

SIX! Bang! Evin Lewis in this mood is very dangerous. Pakistan's neighbouring country India know it as the southpaw hit a quickfire century against them. Flatter and fuller on middle, Lewis clobbers it over cow corner for a maximum. This is now the highest score for a West Indies batsman in T20Is against Pakistan.
Tossed up ball on middle, knocked down to long on for a run.
Shadab Khan to bowl again.

SIX! Lewis is in a hurry! Tanvir bowls a slower short ball on middle, 100 kph, Evin picks the variation in a trice, waits for it before pummeling it over fine leg for a biggie. 24 runs off the over, 11 needed off 36 balls.
Free Hit - Dot ball. Excellent delivery, very full and wide outside off, Lewis tries squeezing it out but fails in his attempt.
Free Hit coming up in the next delivery...
FOUR! Tanvir has lost his radar. Serves a high full toss outside off, Lewis latches onto it and whacks it over backward point for a boundary. Called a no ball for over the waist high full toss!
SIX! High and handsome! Tanvir angles in a full length ball on off, Lewis gets behind the line and hammers it over the bowler's head for another maximum in the over.
Bouncer, a slower one around off, Lewis picks it and decides not to play at it.
SIX! Wow, what a hit! Tanvir delivers it on a length, Lewis hangs back, fetches it from outside off and deposits it over wide long on for a maximum. Packed a punch, literally.
Short and wide outside off, Mohammed slaps it through the line and the point fielder manages a partial stop. A single taken.
Sohail Tanvir is back on.
Cracking yorker, Lewis digs it out to backward square leg and pinches the second run. Tremendous running between the wickets.
Sharp delivery, on a length at 148 kph, Lewis swings his bat and misses. Takes a blow on his thigh pad.
Bouncer! The batsman ducks in time to let that one go over him.
Angles in a length ball on off, Mohammed tries to flick but misses. It goes off his pads to the off side and they cross.
Hits the blockhole, swinging in the air, Lewis digs it out to the off side for a single. 100 up for West Indies!
Full and outside off, Evin tries to heave it over mid-wicket but fails to connect.
Wahab Riaz returns.
Goes down for a slog sweep but inside edges it through backward square leg for one. 14 runs off the over, 39 needed off 48!
SIX! Boom! Lewis is having fun now. Receives a shortish ball with glee and thwacks it over square leg via a pull shot for a biggie.
A googly around middle and off, Lewis defends from the crease.

SIX! Maiden T20I fifty for Lewis to go with one century against India! Floated full ball on off, curving back in, Lewis kneels and muscles his slog sweep all the way over mid-wicket for a maximum. Powerful knock by him!
A full toss on middle, punched back to the bowler who misfields but no run conceded.
Tossed up ball on off, driven through covers for a single.
Shadab Khan is back into the attack.
Sliding down the leg side, Evin fails to flick and it goes off his pads near the stumps. They steal a leg bye.
The batsman works it down the leg side. They pick up a single.
On a length and around off, Jason tries to play it with a straight bat but it catches the inside edge and runs down to fine leg for a run.
Short in length and outside off, Lewis stands back and slaps it square of the wicket on the off side. One run added to the total.

FOUR! Sloppy by Tanvir! Back of a length delivery around off, Lewis swivels with the pull shot and gets it away off the under edge. It whizzes towards Tanvir at short fine leg who makes a complete mess of a relatively simple stop. A boundary conceded and Hasan Ali is not happy. Fielding letting Pakistan down and this is not the first time you are reading this statement.
Full and angling into the batsman, Jason moves across the stumps and nudges it in front of square leg for a single.
Hasan Ali is back on. 62 required off 60 balls.
Tucks it off his pads to deep backward square leg for a run. 11 off the over!
Leans forward to a full ball and plays it down with soft hands towards mid-wicket. Looks for a single but is sent back.
FOUR! The move to bring Malik seems to have backfired. Tossed up ball on off, fuller in length, Mohammed goes inside-out and thumps it over covers for a boundary.
Flatter ball on middle, hit firmly through mid-wicket for one.
Floated ball on middle and leg, Mohammed top edges his attempted paddle shot and it goes over the keeper. Tanvir chases it from short fine leg and boots it. They take a run.
FOUR! Malik starts from around the wicket and serves a very full ball on off, Jason gets forward and drills it through extra cover for a crackling boundary.
Shoaib Malik to have a go.
Flatter and quicker on off, defended off the back foot towards the bowler.

FOUR! Doesn't middle it but still gets a boundary. A googly around off, Lewis gets back to pull without reading the variation and it takes the inner portion of the bat. It runs fine down the leg side and finds the fence.
Drops it mid-way down the track, around off, Mohammed pulls it to deep mid-wicket for one.
A touch too full by Shadab, not allowing the ball to spin, Lewis eases it to long off for a run.
Full in length on middle, a wrong 'un, Mohammed forces it down to long on and gets off the mark.
Loopy leg spinner on off, Jason gets forward and pushes it with gentle hands towards cover-point.
Jason Mohammed is the next batsman in.

OUT! Change in pace has worked for Wahab. He dishes out a slower short ball around off, Samuels sticks back to his crease, fails to read the variation and is early into the shot. As a result, he ends up chipping it in the air and straight to Imad Wasim at long off. He makes no mistake and pumps his fist in celebration. Riaz is ecstatic. That's a big breakthrough for Pakistan. 80 needed off 72 balls.
Fast and furious delivery, full and around off, angling away, Samuels clears his front leg for a massive heave but fails to connect again. Wahab shakes his head in disappointment.
Shortish and around off, a mistimed pull shot by Samuels towards mid-wicket.
Wide! Riaz sees the batsman backing away towards leg and bowls it full and wide outside off, Samuels leaves it alone and it's wided. The margin of error for bowlers is very less in this format.
Shortish and outside off, Lewis stays back and cuts it calypso style to deep point for a run.
On a length and around off, Marlon brings down an angled bat and guides it towards third man for a run.
Play and a miss! Angles across a sharp length delivery outside off, Samuels makes room to slap it through the line but fails to connect.
Wahab Riaz is into the bowling attack.
Outside off, played to point. End of the over.
Excellent! Beats him all ends up. Floats it around off, the googly, which Lewis does not pick. Prods forward to defend but is beaten past the outside edge.
Drags his length back again, this time it's pulled to long on for a run.
50-run stand between Evin Lewis and Marlon Samuels!
FOUR! Short, wide and outside off, width on offer so Samuels is on to it in a flash. Rocks back and cuts it behind backward point to pick up a boundary.
Bowls this slower through the air and tosses it on a driving length around off, Samuels is forward in defense.
Tossed up on middle and leg, driven to long on by Evin Lewis for a single.
The wonder kid, Shadab Khan comes into the attack. 89 needed off 84 balls.
FOUR! 12 runs off the over. A big one for the hosts. Samuels lofts this with ease over mid-wicket and ends the over with a boundary.
The batsman opens the face of the bat and helps it to third man. They pick up a single.

SIX! Monstrous hit! A 94m hit, talk about sweet connection on that. Back of a length, Lewis who is waiting for this, walks out a step and muscles the pull deep into the stands over the wide long on fence for a maximum.
Outside off on a length, shaping away, played away to point. Dot ball.
Samuels gets big and works this shortish ball in front of mid-wicket. The run is on and there is a shy at the bowler's end. It misses so the batsman is safe. Single completed.
Length delivery on off, Samuels with the full face of the blade blocks it back down the track.
Hasan Ali comes into the attack.

SIX! He's finally cut loose here. He's hit that with real power! Fuller outside off, Lewis stands his ground and swings with everything he's got. Doesn't middle it but it's still enough to clear the long on fence comfortably for a biggie.
SIX! BANG! Full on the stumps, Lewis gets low and slog sweeps it over the mid-wicket boundary for a maximum.

That's great work out in the deep by the two fielders. A complete contrast to the two West Indies fielders, Holder and Lewis, earlier. Short and flat around off, it's pulled through mid-wicket. Zaman first dives to his right to get a hand to it, then  Shehzad who comes running towards him from long on slides and keeps the ball away from touching the ropes. Good effort. You need such athleticism especially when you're defending a relatively low total. Only two runs are taken.
Works this through the gap in the mid-wicket region for another single.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Comes down the wicket and eases it to long on for one.
FOUR! Outside off, on a back of a length, Lewis opens the face and guides it late across the third man fence for a boundary.
Angling into the left-hander on a bit of a fuller length, it raps Lewis on the pads while he attempts to go big over the leg side.

THAT'S IN THE AIR... BUT IT'S JUST, JUST SHORT! Oh, that was really close. Fuller length delivery on off, Lewis doesn't time this well at all. Ends up chipping it just in front of Imad Wasim who dives forward to take a low catch but cannot make it.
Length delivery around off, hits it across the line, in the air but well short of mid on. A run is taken.

Wide! But that's a poor call from the umpire. It's definitely gone off something, most likely off the pad. There was clearly some noise. Samuels looks to flick this fullish length ball down the leg side but fails to do so.
Fractionally ahead of a length from Tanvir, outside off, Lewis plays this square of the wicket on the off side for a single.
FOUR! Full and wide outside off, with room on offer Evin Lewis cannot resist. He throws his bat at this and gets it off the outer half. Clears the point fielder and gets a boundary to his name.
Marlon Samuels has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery. Another good over from Imad. Just 2 off it.
Darts this full and flat outside off, Samuels dances down the track and drives but can only hit it in the direction of the bowler. Another dot ball.
Wide! Slips this down the leg side, easy call for the umpire. Wide signalled.
This time the southpaw makes connection and cuts it away towards point for a single.
Just back of a length, around off, Evin Lewis once again stays back to cut it hard but is beaten past the outside edge.
On the shorter side of things, this time Lewis offers a back foot punch to mid off.
Flat, short and outside off, Evin backs away and punches it away to cover-point for nothing.
Outside off, on a back of a length, Samuels taps it in front of covers. Lewis wants the run but is sent back. Would have been safe even if the shy at the bowler's end hit.

FOUR! Poor ball and that's dispatched. He'll feast on them all day. Full on the pads, Marlon flicks it in front of square easily. There's a huge gap there and the ball races away to the fence for a boundary.
Good, tight line from Tanvir. He hurls this on a length aiming the top of off stump, doesn't give Samuels any room to do anything but defend.
Tailing back in on middle and leg, worked away on the leg side for a single.
Marlon Samuels is the next man in.

OUT! Tanvir strikes instantly! Not a great delivery though from Tanvir, he fires it fuller on the pads, Walton flicks it aerially over square leg. Fakhar Zaman out in the deep comes running in and dives forward to pouch it in both his hands. This dismissal is similar to how Shoaib Malik got out earlier in the first innings. Zaman did well to time the dive and take the catch. Pakistan off to a good start.
Back of a length delivery going across, Chadwick Walton stands tall, looks to cut but gets an inside edge onto his pads. No run taken.
Sohail Tanvir will bowl from the other end.
First runs of the bat for West Indies. Walton eases this down to long on for a single. Good first over from Imad Wasim. Just 2 runs off it.
Full and darted flat on middle and off, Walton with the full face of the bat pushes it back to the bowler by leaning ahead.
Short and flat, going slightly down leg, goes off Lewis' pads as he goes for the big pull. A leg bye is taken.
Fullish in length from Imad, it's played back to him by the southpaw.
Short and wide outside off, cut away to point off the back foot towards point.
From around the wicket, Wasim attacks the stumps without wasting any time. Bowls it flat and on a length as Lewis goes back to push it back down the track.
We are back for the chase. Evin Lewis and Chadwick Walton are the two openers for the Windies. Imad Wasim will kick things off with the ball for the Men in Green. Here we go...
